rationale: The authenticated, independent scoring records weaken recorded-score alteration, and specification fixation before bidder identities were available weakens bidder-specific authorship. This bounded weakening of the two examined routes follows without establishing honest intent or excluding other steering routes.

signal_basis.exact_text: Independently retained evaluation sheets agree with the announced scores, including the retained scoring history. No post-evaluation change appears in either independent copy.
Dated drafting records establish that the examined specification was fixed before bidder identities were available.
Copies and dates are authenticated and independent. The evidence concerns the two named routes only; it does not record unexamined contacts or prove honest intent.
